params.name: Input
params.description: The node whose surface is extruded as a whole: its points move along their normals and walls rise from its open edges.

params.name: Distance
params.description: How far, in world units, each point moves along its point normal to form the top. Negative extrudes inward, against the normals.

params.name: Keep Base
params.description: Keep the original faces, reversed, as the bottom so a sheet becomes a closed slab. Off leaves only the top and the side walls.
